name: @kennedy1020/vibe-shield
description: Zero-config security auditor and slopsquatting detector for Next.js, Supabase, Prisma, Stripe, Paystack, and PayPal stacks

scripts.test: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('node dist/cli.js scan test/fixtures', { stdio: 'pipe' }); console.error('Test failed: vulnerabilities were not detected'); process.exit(1); } catch (err) { if (err.status === 1) { console.log('✅ Test passed: CLI correctly detected fixture vulnerabilities with exit code 1'); process.exit(0); } throw err; }"
